spec.text:
Spec decisions

- Built on HA climate features: hvac_modes, fan_modes, swing_modes, swing_horizontal_modes, preset_modes, target_temp_step. Dual setpoints (feature 2) render as two knobs on the inner ring.
- Daikin Onecta auto-detect: humidity, outdoor temp, energy day/week/month, cloud rate limit, error/warning/caution states.
- Inner ring = setpoint, outer ring = fan (auto, quiet, 1-5). Both draggable.
- Writes debounced 1.5 s after release; taps coalesce into one call.
- temperature_sensor option: shows external room sensor, unit reading small.
- status_entities slot under the dial.
- Glass tint follows hvac mode. Rich motion, off under prefers-reduced-motion.
- English only, visual editor, CSS variables for tint, blur, radius.

finding.text:
Finding from your HA (13 Nov)

On Daikin Onecta the climate entity's own device holds only 2 entities (climate + refresh). Humidity, outdoor temp, energy and health live on child devices (regeling, gateway, indoor and outdoor unit) linked by via_device.

So detection walks the device family, not just the device. Matching uses device_class, unit and translation_key, never the entity name: your sensors are renamed to Dutch.
